# 4 Ezra Chapter 12 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 12:12 — the fourth kingdom / Daniel connection

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "is-the-fourth-kingdom which-appeared-in-a-vision to-your-brother-Daniel" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "is the fourth kingdom which appeared in a vision to your brother Daniel" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "is the fourth kingdom that appeared in a vision to your brother Daniel" | Minor variation "which/that" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Is the fourth kingdom which appeared in a vision to your brother Daniel" (LOGOS). "Your brother Daniel" is the important phrase — establishes Ezra's awareness of Daniel's visions.

---

## 12:26 — "bring to a head" / "consummate"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-bring-to-a-head his-wickedness" | Literal — ad caput perducent |
| LOGOS | "shall consummate his wickedness" | "Consummate" captures the completeness |
| PNEUMA | "will bring its wickedness to its peak" | Paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Shall bring his wickedness to completion" — combines the sense of both LOGOS and PNEUMA more naturally.

---

## 12:33 — the Messiah of David's line

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "this-is-the-Messiah whom-the-Most-High-has-kept" | Preserves "Messiah" as title |
| LOGOS | "this is the Messiah whom the Most High has kept" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "he is the Messiah whom the Most High has been preserving" | "Has been preserving" is present perfect |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "This is the Messiah whom the Most High has kept until the end of days" (LOGOS). The simple perfect "has kept" is accurate and the full phrase "until the end of days" should be retained.

---

## 12:38–39 — writing and hiding the book

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "put-it-in-a-hidden-place" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "put it in a hidden place" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "hide it away" | Compressed |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Put it in a hidden place" (LOGOS). The specificity of "hidden place" is significant — it echoes the motif of concealed scriptures that climaxes in chapter 14.

---

## 12:42–43 — world grown old metaphor

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-world-has-lost-its-youth, and-the-times-begin-to-wax-old" | Literal; "wax old" is archaic |
| LOGOS | "the world has lost its youth, and the times begin to grow old" | Updates "wax old" to "grow old" |
| PNEUMA | "the world has passed its youth, and the times are growing old" | Same meaning, different phrasing |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "The world has lost its youth, and the times begin to grow old" (LOGOS). "Lost its youth" is more vivid than PNEUMA's "passed its youth."

---

## Total disagreements: 5
